business_problem: Scam victims often report fraud only after their money has been transferred and become difficult to trace. Banks need to identify money-mule accounts before they receive or move illicit funds, including before a payment is completed.
solution_summary: Cybera's Money Mule Intelligence uses AI-generated personas that pose as plausible victims and engage scammers until they request payment and disclose receiving-account details. Cybera runs hundreds of personas across thousands of conversations each day, using the collected details to identify accounts while they are active. It verifies each account and attaches evidence and context for bank fraud teams. The intelligence is made available through Recorded Future, enabling financial institutions to check receiving accounts in real time before a transfer completes, as in the described private-bank intervention. Banks can also use the intelligence to identify mule accounts among their own customers before illicit funds arrive. The source does not describe the underlying data-ingestion, model-training, storage, or bank-system integration architecture.

solution_components.name: Money Mule Intelligence
solution_components.role: Uses AI-generated personas to collect payment-account details from scammers and provides verified account intelligence with evidence and context to banks.

solution_components.name: Recorded Future
solution_components.role: Makes Cybera's Money Mule Intelligence available to financial institutions.

data_flow: AI personas engage scammers in conversations and collect payment details; Cybera identifies and verifies the disclosed accounts and attaches evidence and context. The intelligence is made available through Recorded Future, and banks check receiving accounts against it in real time before transfers, or use it to identify mule accounts among their customers.
integration_points: Financial institutions' fraud teams and payment checks
business_outcome: Helps financial institutions identify money-mule accounts and intervene before transfers reach them; also helps banks find mule accounts within their own customer bases before they are used to receive or move illicit funds.
metrics: Cybera runs hundreds of these personas across thousands of conversations every day.

source_references.title: AI is a scammer’s superpower. This startup uses AI to outsmart them

evidence_quotes: To find them, it uses AI-generated personas that engage scammers and gather payment details.
Cybera runs hundreds of these personas across thousands of conversations every day.
The bank checked the receiving account against a list of accounts confirmed to belong to scammers. When a match popped up, the bank was able to intervene.
Cybera goes beyond estimating the likelihood of fraud by verifying each account and attaching evidence and context that helps banks make a strong case to the customer.
